svg.text: DDIA 1 · TRADE-OFFS IN DATA SYSTEMS ARCHITECTURE
No perfect systems, only trade-offs: operational or analytical, source or derived, cloud or self-hosted, one node or many.

One system of record per fact; caches and indexes are derived and rebuildable.
Managed for small teams and spiky load; self-host when load is big and steady or control matters.
Delete everywhere derived data went; crypto-shred immutable logs and backups.
